name: australian-privacy-cybersecurity
description: Verify the APP framework and identify Australian privacy, cybersecurity, data-breach and AI-use-case risks using current legislation.

interface.shortDescription: Map privacy, breach and AI use-case risks.
interface.longDescription: Helps lawyers verify the applicable Australian Privacy Principles framework, identify Australian privacy and cybersecurity issues, assess suspected data breaches, and evaluate defined AI-system use cases. It detects APP changes across the decision horizon, verifies legislation through the repository's legislation skills, separates law from guidance and assumptions, excludes case law, and reserves conclusions and approvals for human review.
defaultPrompt: Verify the applicable APP framework and detect changes across the relevant dates.
Identify the Australian privacy and cybersecurity issues raised by these facts.
Assess this suspected data breach and prepare a lawyer-review action matrix.
Map the potentially applicable Australian privacy legislation and identify missing facts.
Assess whether this AI-system use case is suitable and identify required controls.
